clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, Iverron's Antidote must reach a young night elf before it spoils. Dirania Silvershine brews it to counter the lethal venom of local Webwood spiders, but it lasts only five minutes.

Dirania Silvershine brews the antidote in Aldrassil for Iverron, a young night elf bitten by Webwood spiders. Its volatile ingredients and herbal catalysts give the draught a shelf life of only five minutes. Couriers must hurry north to the Webwood cave and deliver it before it spoils.
